target.statement: GMC test accuracy on the WDBC breast cancer dataset (0.970 ± 0.010, mean over 3 seeds)
target.dataset: WDBC (UCI Breast Cancer Wisconsin Diagnostic), 569 samples, 2 classes, 30 features

compute.basis: Tiny tabular dataset (569x30) and a small per-class hyperplane model trained on CPU in <1s per the paper's own timing table; the main cost is re-implementing the GMC training recipe (k-means init, alpha annealing, usage-aware L2, early stopping) from the paper since the linked repo is unverified, plus 3 seeds and baseline comparison.

blockers: Linked GitHub repo is unverified/possibly empty or incomplete; the GMC training recipe must likely be re-implemented from the paper text
Exact splits, seeds, and preprocessing details are only partially specified (60/20/20 stratified, seeds {0,1,2})
Exact reproduction of 0.970 ± 0.010 may be sensitive to unspecified hyperparameter details
title: Geometric Mixture Classifier (GMC): A Discriminative Per-Class Mixture of Hyperplanes
